name: A Very American Christmas Parade in Downtown Melbourne
venue: East New Haven Avenue parade route
address: E New Haven Ave, Melbourne, FL 32901
paras: Downtown Melbourne lists A Very American Christmas Parade on Saturday, December 12, 2026 from 10 AM to 1 PM, and marks the event Free on its calendar.
The host describes a day of holiday magic in Historic Downtown Melbourne with festive floats, bands, performers and Santa, and invites the whole family.
The event listing places the parade on East New Haven Avenue in Melbourne, FL 32901.
The same Downtown Melbourne calendar lists a Candlelight Shopping Cookie Crawl later that day, from 4 to 8 PM.

name: Kids' Holiday Hangout at Brevard Zoo
paras: Brevard Zoo invites parents to drop kids off for a Kids' Holiday Hangout on Saturday, December 12, 2026 from 5 to 8 PM while they enjoy a night out.
The zoo lists up-close animal encounters, holiday themed games, crafts and a pizza dinner.
Tickets are $34 for members and $40 for nonmembers and are sold through the zoo's ticket page.
The zoo's other December programs include Jolly Days on December 19, with Santa and Mrs. Claus, and a Holly Jolly Brunch on December 20.

name: Candlelight Shopping Cookie Crawl in Downtown Melbourne
address: Historic Downtown Melbourne, FL (tin pick-up at 2004 Vernon Place)
paras: Melbourne Main Street holds the 3rd annual Cookie Crawl in Historic Downtown Melbourne on Saturday, December 12, 2026 from 4 to 8 PM. Cost is $25.
Guests pick up a keepsake tin at 2004 Vernon Place and stroll from shop to shop collecting cookies from participating downtown businesses.
The host also lists photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus, the Grinch and candlelight shopping until 8 PM.
Melbourne Main Street says the crawl sold out last year and advises buying tickets early.
